remarks: Newly renovated inside and out! This beautifully renovated 1st floor, 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath apartment is ready for immediate occupancy. The apartment is a perfect blend of modern style and convenience. Step inside to find brand-new flooring, updated lighting, updated bathrooms, and a sleek kitchen featuring new cabinets, granite countertops and new stainless-steel appliances. The unit also includes the convenience of in-unit laundry, air conditioning and a charming front porch, perfect for enjoying a great book! Located in a vibrant area, you'll have easy access to local restaurants, shops, parks, and the quick connections to I-95 and Route 1 make commuting a breeze! With off street parking, and additional storage provided in your own space located within the garage, this apartment truly has it all-comfort, style and accessibility! Schedule today.
